summary: The project aims to create a remote control prioritizing aesthetics over functionality using off-the-shelf components, an advanced chip, and an LCD display. Budget constraints, exceeded by 4 euros, led to concessions such as using plastic instead of rubber and a single-curved design. The team proposed a final product with a plastic solid case, LCD display, and single-curved design. The prototype's design and LCD screen are key selling points but its radical design may be a barrier. The team reflected on ergonomics, user requirements, and marketing strategies, proposing improvements such as adjusting the joystick position and adding a rubber grip for a more ergonomic design, scoring 3 out of 5 in satisfaction.
